verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer graphics card. A sandbox environment kept separate from production data is a service or API capability, so this story is a category error for GPU hardware. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a capability; the CUDA containers and toolkit are developer building blocks, not a sandbox for production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
